# Story 21 — Agent availability toggle

## Prerequisites

- `backend/src/models/User.ts` already declares `isOnline: boolean` (interface line 54, schema default `false` line 119). No schema migration required.
- `backend/src/routes/admin.routes.ts` already surfaces `isOnline` on both the staff-list projection (line 87, `.select("… isOnline …")`) and the per-user shape returned to the admin UI (line 33). Admin-visibility side of the acceptance criteria is largely already wired — verify only.
- `backend/src/routes/admin.routes.ts` already forces `isOnline = false` on deactivation (lines 254, 303). This story must preserve that invariant: a deactivated user cannot go back online.
- Related, but explicitly **not** implemented here: Story 10 (ticket auto-assign) and Story 17 (chat auto-assign) will filter by `isOnline: true`. Their acceptance criteria are unblocked by, but not delivered in, this story.
- Follows the self-scoped `me.routes.ts` precedent — no new permission key, `requireAuth` only. See `backend/src/routes/me.routes.ts` `GET /status` (line 22) and `PATCH /contact` (line 44).

---

## Story Goal

Make `User.isOnline` a real, agent-controlled flag:

1. A signed-in agent can flip their own `isOnline` on/off from a small, always-reachable UI surface (header/user menu on staff pages).
2. Admins can already see an agent's current online state in the existing users list (`/admin/users`) — this story verifies that end-to-end and does not build a new admin view.
3. The endpoint enforces the two invariants that matter for downstream auto-assignment: only `role === "agent"` may set `isOnline: true`, and a deactivated user (`isActive === false`) cannot be online.

**Explicitly out of scope:** consumption of `isOnline` inside auto-assignment queries (Stories 10 & 17), a full unified dashboard (Story 20), and socket-driven presence for other staff to watch each other in real time.

## Backend Tasks

### 1 — Add `PATCH /api/v1/me/availability`

**File:** `backend/src/routes/me.routes.ts`

Add a new handler above the `/email/confirm` GET, mirroring the shape of `PATCH /contact`:

```ts
// PATCH /api/v1/me/availability — agent self-flip of isOnline. Self-scoped,
// so requireAuth only (no permission key), matching /me/contact's precedent.
// Guarded so only role === "agent" can go online: admins/sub-admins/customers
// are never auto-assigned to tickets or chats, so isOnline is meaningless for
// them; reject with 403 rather than silently no-op'ing. Deactivated users
// (isActive === false) also cannot go online — admin.routes.ts already forces
// isOnline=false on deactivation (lines 254, 303) and we must not let it
// bounce back on afterwards.
router.patch("/availability", requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const parsed = availabilityBodySchema.safeParse(req.body ?? {});
  if (!parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid request" });
    return;
  }
  const user = await User.findById(req.user!.id);
  if (!user) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "User not found" });
    return;
  }
  if (user.role !== "agent") {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "Only agents can set availability" });
    return;
  }
  if (parsed.data.isOnline && !user.isActive) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "Deactivated account cannot go online" });
    return;
  }
  user.isOnline = parsed.data.isOnline;
  await user.save();
  res.status(200).json({ isOnline: user.isOnline });
});
```

Also extend the existing `GET /status` handler at **line 22–29** to include `isOnline` in its projection and response body, so the header component can hydrate the toggle on first paint without a second round-trip:

- `.select("role isActive permissions isOnline")`
- `res.status(200).json({ role, isActive, permissions: permissions ?? [], isOnline })`

Import the new schema at the top of the file alongside `contactBodySchema`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Non-agent tries to flip themselves online.** Handler returns 403 "Only agents can set availability" (backend Task 1, guard after user load). Frontend never renders the menu item for non-agents, so the 403 is defense-in-depth for direct API callers.
- **Deactivated agent tries to flip online.** Handler returns 403 "Deactivated account cannot go online" (backend Task 1). Keeps the invariant `admin.routes.ts` already enforces on deactivation (lines 254, 303).
- **Admin deactivates an agent mid-session while that agent is online.** `admin.routes.ts` already sets `isOnline = false` in that path (line 254). No additional work here — but the frontend toggle should re-hydrate from `/me/status` on next request so the agent sees the truth. Covered by `revalidatePath` in Task 5.
- **Missing body / `isOnline` not a boolean.** Zod schema rejects with 400 and the exact message from `availabilityBodySchema`.
- **Access token expired mid-flip.** Server action retries once after `refreshSession()` (Task 5, following `settings/actions.ts` lines 37–44). If refresh fails, return `{ ok: false }` — the UI reverts to the pre-optimistic state and shows `availabilityUpdateFailed`.
- **Two tabs open, agent toggles in tab A.** Tab B stays stale until it either re-renders (revalidation from `revalidatePath`) or re-fetches `/me/status`. Documented, not fixed — real-time sync belongs to Story 20/21's full dashboard scope.
- **Customer role hitting the endpoint.** Same 403 branch as any non-agent; UI never shows the item.

## Verification Steps

1. **Backend builds:** `cd backend && npm run build` — must pass with no new TS errors.
2. **Backend tests:** `cd backend && npm test -- me.routes` and `cd backend && npm test -- admin.routes`.
3. **Frontend runs:** `cd frontend && npm run dev`. Sign in as a seeded agent. Open the header user menu → confirm the "Available / Away" row appears, defaults to Away (schema default), flips on click, and the dot color changes. Sign in as an admin: the row must be absent.
4. **Admin cross-check:** as admin, open `/admin/users` — the row for the agent you just flipped online must display the "yes" state (per `frontend/app/admin/users/page.tsx:98`).
5. **Regression — deactivation invariant:** as admin, deactivate that same agent from `/admin/users`. Re-log in as the agent → attempt the toggle → expect an error toast/message (`availabilityUpdateFailed`) and confirm via DB or admin list that `isOnline` stays `false`.
6. **Regression — non-agent 403:** with browser devtools, send `PATCH /api/v1/me/availability` from an admin session → 403.
